newsitem.title: HONG KONG: No reason for Thai crisis to develop further.
newsitem.headline: No reason for Thai crisis to develop further.

text.p: International Monetary Fund (IMF) chief Michel Camdessus said in Hong Kong on Friday he saw no reason for Thailand's financial sector problems to worsen.
The Thai authorities were mindful "of the need to act speedily and in a permanent dialogue with international financial institutions...," Camdessus said.

"We are ready to continue assisting them in this effort and I don't see any particular reason for this crisis to develop further," he told an IMF-Hong Kong Monetary Authority Conference on financial integration in Asia and the role of Hong Kong.
